# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
# Source is an explicit named build context, pinned by Compose to the inspected
# upstream 0.5.0 commit. A trusted local checkout can be supplied instead.
FROM rust:1.95.0-bookworm AS wiki-builder
WORKDIR /src
COPY --from=llm_wiki / /src/
RUN grep -q '^version = "0.5.0"$' Cargo.toml \
    && cargo build --release --locked --bin pwc-llm-wiki \
    && test "$(target/release/pwc-llm-wiki --version)" = 'pwc-llm-wiki 0.5.0'

# Reuse the pinned Rust distribution for its git/runtime libraries. This favors
# a verifiable source build over an unavailable upstream binary release.
FROM rust:1.95.0-bookworm
RUN useradd --uid 1000 --create-home wiki \
    && mkdir -p /data /opt/json2pptx/docs \
    && chown wiki:wiki /data
COPY --from=wiki-builder /src/target/release/pwc-llm-wiki /usr/local/bin/pwc-llm-wiki
COPY scripts/wiki.sh /usr/local/bin/json2pptx-wiki
COPY wiki.toml /opt/json2pptx/wiki.toml
COPY schemas /opt/json2pptx/schemas
COPY docs/wiki /opt/json2pptx/docs/wiki
ENV JSON2PPTX_WIKI_REPO=/opt/json2pptx \
    JSON2PPTX_WIKI_STATE_DIR=/data
USER wiki
WORKDIR /opt/json2pptx
ENTRYPOINT ["json2pptx-wiki"]
CMD ["serve"]
